jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dedicated and customer-focused Account Manager to join our Sales Department at Ninja. The Account Manager will be responsible for maintaining relationships with existing partner restaurants, ensuring their satisfaction and success on the Ninja platform. The ideal candidate possesses strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to account management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for existing partner restaurants, building and nurturing relationships to ensure satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct regular check-ins with partners to review performance, address concerns, and explore growth opportunities.
  • Provide ongoing support and assistance to partners, addressing inquiries and resolving issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Sales Acquisition and Operations, to facilitate partner onboarding and transition.
  • Monitor partner performance metrics and KPIs, identifying areas for improvement and implementing action plans as needed.
  • Coordinate marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns with partners to drive engagement and sales.
  • Cross-selling NCR products and monitor ROI for partners.
  • Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, communications, and performance using CRM software.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities to provide strategic insights and recommendations to partners.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • 3 years of experience in account management, customer service, or sales roles.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • A proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving.

jobs.title: Category Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Ninja as a Category Specialist and take the lead in managing our delightful range of sweet products! In this role, you'll be responsible for developing category strategies that drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction. You will conduct market analysis, monitor trends, and collaborate with various teams to ensure our sweet offerings captivate consumers and perform exceptionally.

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Analyze market trends and consumer preferences specific to the sweets category to inform product assortment and pricing strategies.
  • Develop and manage relationships with suppliers to secure high-quality sweet products while optimizing cost and availability.
  • Collaborate with merchandising and marketing teams to enhance product visibility and create impactful promotional campaigns.
  • Monitor category performance metrics and utilize data to make informed decisions that drive sales and profitability.
  • Conduct regular reviews of category performance, adjusting strategies as necessary to meet market demands and business objectives.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of seasonal and promotional product launches.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities to ensure Ninja remains a leader in the sweet products category.

jobs.title: Category Specialist - Fresh Food
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Category Specialist to join our Commercial team. The role will support category planning and execution by analyzing commercial performance, managing product lifecycle activities, monitoring pricing and promotions, and maintaining an effective product assortment.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and experience in retail, FMCG, e-commerce, buying, merchandising, or category management.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze category sales, margins, profitability, inventory, customer behavior, and product performance.
  • Monitor category KPIs and prepare reports to support commercial decisions.
  • Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, pricing movements, and assortment opportunities.
  • Execute category plans in line with the company’s commercial objectives.
  • Coordinate new product listings, assortment changes, and product discontinuations.
  • Maintain accurate product information, hierarchy, attributes, and master data.
  • Monitor product availability and inventory performance to minimize shortages and excess stock.
  • Support pricing reviews, promotional planning, and merchandising activities.
  • Evaluate promotional performance and recommend improvements.
  • Coordinate with suppliers regarding pricing, product information, promotions, and commercial requirements.
  • Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Inventory, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Merchandising, and Quality teams.
  • Prepare category reports, dashboards, presentations, forecasts, and commercial summaries.
  • Maintain pricing files, promotional calendars, and category documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in category management, commercial operations, buying, merchandising, retail, FMCG, e-commerce, or a related commercial role.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret sales, margin, inventory, and customer data.
  • Good understanding of category management, product lifecycle, pricing, promotions, and assortment planning.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and business intelligence tools such as Power BI is preferred.
  • Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced commercial environment.

jobs.title: Commercial Planning Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Commercial Planning Manager to lead commercial planning activities across assortment, inventory health, SKU productivity, and range optimization.

The role will translate commercial strategy into actionable plans that improve assortment productivity, reduce overstock, optimize inventory, and support profitable growth. You will work closely with Category Management, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Master Data, Commercial Excellence, and Media Buying teams to drive planning decisions and ensure strong execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assortment planning and range optimization across categories.
  • Monitor inventory health, overstock, slow-moving and aged stock, and drive clearance actions.
  • Lead SKU rationalization to improve product and category productivity.
  • Analyze sales, margin, stock cover, availability, and SKU performance to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and seasonal commercial planning activities.
  • Work closely with Category Management, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, and other key stakeholders to align plans and drive execution.
  • Provide commercial insights and recommendations to support management decision-making.

Requirements

  • Planning, Category Planning, Retail Planning, or a similar role.
  • Strong experience in assortment planning, inventory management, SKU rationalization, and range optimization.
  • Strong understanding of retail commercial metrics such as sales, margin, sell-through, stock cover, inventory value, and SKU productivity.
  • Experience working closely with Category Management and Supply/Demand Planning teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong ability to work with data and planning reports.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate data and analysis into clear commercial actions and recommendations.

jobs.title: Dispatch Agent
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Dispatch Agent to support fast-paced last-mile delivery operations. The role is responsible for coordinating and monitoring orders from pickup to customer delivery, ensuring efficient dispatching, timely deliveries, and quick resolution of operational issues.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and dispatch orders to delivery partners efficiently.
  • Monitor active deliveries and ensure orders are delivered within the expected timeframe.
  • Communicate with delivery partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operations.
  • Track order status and take immediate action on delayed, cancelled, or problematic orders.
  • Resolve operational issues and escalate critical cases when required.
  • Follow up on delivery performance and ensure service-level targets are met.
  • Maintain accurate dispatch and delivery records.
  • Support daily operations and contribute to improving delivery efficiency and customer experience.

Requirements

  • 0–3 years of experience in dispatch, logistics, delivery operations, or a related field.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to work with operational systems.
  • Good command of English; Arabic is a plus.
  • Willingness to work in shifts, including weekends when required.

jobs.title: Fleet Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Fleet Supervisor to oversee daily fleet operations and ensure maximum vehicle availability, safety, compliance, and cost efficiency. The ideal candidate will have experience managing transportation fleets, vehicle maintenance, driver performance, and operational reporting within a fast-paced logistics or supply chain environment.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily fleet operations to ensure maximum vehicle availability and operational efficiency.
  • Manage vehicle allocation and driver assignments based on business and delivery requirements.
  • Monitor fleet utilization and identify opportunities to improve productivity and reduce downtime.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective vehicle maintenance activities with workshops and service providers.
  • Ensure all vehicles maintain valid registrations, insurance, inspections, and regulatory documentation.
  • Track fuel consumption, maintenance expenses, and other fleet-related costs while supporting cost optimization initiatives.
  • Monitor vehicle condition and ensure all safety standards and company policies are consistently followed.
  • Investigate vehicle accidents, damages, traffic violations, and operational incidents, and implement corrective actions when required.
  • Supervise driver performance, attendance, compliance, and adherence to safety procedures.
  • Support driver onboarding, training, and performance improvement programs.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Warehouse, Procurement, Finance, and external vendors to ensure smooth fleet operations.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate fleet records, reports, and operational documentation.
  • Generate regular fleet performance reports and KPIs for management review.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and implement solutions to enhance efficiency, service levels, and fleet performance.
  • Support fleet expansion, optimization, and continuous improvement projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Transportation, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Fleet Operations, Transportation, Logistics, or Supply Chain.
  • Minimum 2 years of supervisory experience.
  • Experience managing commercial vehicles, vans, trucks, or distribution fleets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet management and transportation operations.
  • Experience in vehicle maintenance management and compliance.
  • Knowledge of cost control, route planning, and vendor management.
  • Strong reporting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
  • Strong communication and team coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment.

jobs.title: Ground Operation Team Member

  • Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

jobs.title: Inbound Officer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Inbound Officer to join our logistics operations team. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and efficient receiving operations by verifying inbound shipments, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring proper documentation. The Inbound Officer will coordinate closely with warehouse, transportation, and quality teams to ensure smooth daily operations.

Responsibilities:

    • Supervise and execute inbound receiving operations and unloading activities.
    • Verify received goods against invoices, purchase orders, and delivery notes.
    • Inspect product quality, quantity, and expiration dates to ensure compliance with company standards.
    • Report damaged items, shortages, or discrepancies immediately.
    • Manage batch creation and ensure proper labeling of received goods.
    • Organize and transfer received pallets to designated warehouse zones.
    • Coordinate truck scheduling and gate management to avoid delays and congestion.
    • Maintain accurate receiving records and update transactions in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
    • Prepare daily receiving and discrepancy reports.
    • Follow all safety, quality, and operational procedures.

Requirements

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in warehouse receiving or inbound operations.
  • Good knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and barcode scanning.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Ability to lift and move materials when required and stand for extended periods.
  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field is preferred.

jobs.title: Incubation Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re growing fast, and we’re looking for an Incubation Specialist to help our restaurant partners grow with us.

You’ll own partner relationships, spot growth opportunities, drive campaigns, and make sure partners are performing at their best — from increasing orders and revenue to improving day-to-day operations.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or E-commerce.
  • Experience in FoodTech, F&B, hospitality, or online delivery.
  • Commercial mindset with strong negotiation and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and performance dashboards.
  • Proactive, hands-on, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in Arabic & English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

jobs.title: Internal Replenishment Team Leader
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Internal Replenishment Team Leader to manage and oversee all replenishment activities within the warehouse. The role ensures the continuous and accurate flow of stock from bulk storage to picking locations to support daily operations and maintain high product availability.

Responsibilities

    • Lead and supervise the warehouse replenishment team during daily operations.
    • Ensure timely and accurate replenishment from bulk storage to picking locations.
    • Monitor pick-face stock levels and maintain availability targets.
    • Review replenishment reports and resolve shortages or location discrepancies.
    • Coordinate with receiving, put-away, picking, and dispatch teams to ensure workflow efficiency.
    • Maintain inventory accuracy through regular checks and proper stock rotation (FIFO/FEFO).
    • Optimize storage usage and improve replenishment processes.
    • Ensure compliance with warehouse safety and operational standards.
    • Train, coach, and evaluate staff performance.
    • Prepare daily KPI and operational reports for management.

Requirements

    • 2–5 years of warehouse operations experience (Retail or FMCG preferred).
    • Previous experience in replenishment, inventory, or logistics.
    • Strong knowledge of WMS and RF scanners.
    • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
    • High attention to detail and accuracy.

jobs.title: Operations Manger
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to oversee the end-to-end operations of our FMCG warehouse. This role is responsible for ensuring efficient warehouse performance, accurate inventory management, cost control, safety compliance, and timely order fulfillment.

The successful candidate will lead warehouse teams, monitor operational KPIs, and implement continuous improvement initiatives within a fast-paced, high-volume distribution environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, and outbound dispatch.
  • Ensure smooth material flow and compliance with operational SOPs, service-level agreements, and safety standards.
  • Monitor key warehouse KPIs, including order fulfillment, picking accuracy, OTIF, dock-to-stock time, and employee productivity.
  • Lead and supervise warehouse supervisors, team leaders, pickers, and forklift operators.
  • Plan manpower requirements, shifts, and productivity targets according to operational volumes and seasonal demand.
  • Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and support employee development.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement lean warehouse practices.
  • Improve picking methods, including batch, wave, and zone picking, to increase productivity.
  • Support the effective utilization of warehouse management systems, automation, and process digitization.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, stock audits, and reconciliation.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFO/FEFO procedures, expiry-date controls, and damage-prevention practices.
  • Coordinate with Inventory Control teams to investigate and resolve stock variances and shrinkage.
  • Control warehouse operating costs, including labor, equipment, and consumables.
  • Optimize warehouse space utilization and material-handling efficiency.
  • Support capacity planning, layout optimization, new SKU onboarding, seasonal peaks, and volume increases.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE, food safety, and applicable local regulations.
  • Maintain a safe working environment and reduce workplace incidents and operational risks.
  • Ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment and resolve escalated operational issues affecting service levels.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in warehouse or operations management.
  • At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial position.
  • Previous experience in an FMCG warehouse or high-volume distribution environment is required.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of inbound receiving, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch operations.
  • Good understanding of inventory management, FIFO/FEFO, productivity KPIs, and warehouse cost control.
  • Proficiency in Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and operational reporting.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and people-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced warehouse environment.

jobs.title: Outbound Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Outbound Supervisor to oversee daily outbound warehouse operations and ensure orders are picked, consolidated, staged, and dispatched accurately and on time. The role will supervise the outbound team, manage manpower, monitor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, food safety, and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily outbound operations, including picking, consolidation, staging, loading, and dispatch.
  • Allocate manpower based on workload, order volume, and shift requirements.
  • Monitor order accuracy, productivity, throughput, backlog, and on-time dispatch.
  • Resolve operational issues and outbound discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Inventory, Stock Control, Distribution, Transportation, and QA teams.
  • Ensure proper handling of damaged, expired, and temperature-sensitive products.
  • Monitor team attendance, performance, and adherence to SOPs.
  • Prepare shift reports and follow up on performance improvement actions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes and productivity

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of relevant experience in warehouse, outbound, fulfillment, logistics, or distribution operations.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience.
  • Strong knowledge of outbound warehouse processes and order fulfillment.
  • Experience with WMS and warehouse operational systems.
  • Good understanding of FIFO/FEFO, inventory control, food safety, and warehouse safety.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume warehouse environment.
  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

jobs.title: Pharmacist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate and skilled Pharmacist to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will not only dispense medications but also provide personalized care and advice to our patients, ensuring they have the best possible outcomes from their treatments.

Main Responsibilities

  • Accurately process and dispense prescription medications, ensuring compliance with legal, ethical, and professional standards.
  • Offer medication counseling to patients, addressing their questions and concerns regarding treatments, side effects, and interactions.
  • Work collaboratively with healthcare providers to create and manage medication treatment plans tailored to each patient's needs.
  • Monitor patient health outcomes and adjust prescriptions as necessary in conjunction with medical staff.
  • Conduct regular training sessions for staff and patients regarding medication safety and wellness.
  • Maintain and manage pharmacy inventory, ensuring adequate stock levels and minimizing waste.
  • Stay informed about new developments in medications and pharmacy practice to continually enhance service delivery.

Requirements

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) degree from an accredited institution.
  • Active pharmacist license in the state of practice.
  • Minimum 3 years of pharmaceutical experience in Saudi Arabia preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of pharmacotherapy and clinical guidelines.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Commitment to continuous education and staying current in the pharmacy field.

jobs.title: Putaway Team Leader
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Putaway Team Leader to lead the putaway team within our fast-growing grocery distribution center.

In this role, you will supervise forklift and reach truck operators and ensure that received goods are moved from the receiving dock to their correct storage locations safely, accurately, and within the required time.

Safety is the first priority of this role, before speed and volume.

Key Responsibilities

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all forklift/MHE operators hold valid and current licenses before operating equipment.
  • Enforce PPE requirements and warehouse safety standards.
  • Conduct daily pre-shift equipment checks and immediately remove unsafe equipment from service.
  • Enforce warehouse traffic rules and maintain safe separation between pedestrians and MHE.
  • Ensure safe stacking, load stability, height limits, and rack capacity.
  • Inspect racking for damage and report any issues immediately.
  • Report, investigate, and document incidents and near-misses.
  • Stop unsafe practices immediately and provide appropriate coaching or retraining.
  • Maintain clean and obstruction-free aisles throughout the shift.

Putaway Operations

  • Ensure received goods are accurately entered into the system, including item, quantity, batch, expiry, and location.
  • Act as the final checkpoint before storage by identifying receiving errors and returning discrepancies to the Receiving team.
  • Assign daily putaway tasks and balance workload according to inbound volume.
  • Ensure goods move from dock to storage location within the required target time.
  • Confirm item, quantity, and storage location accuracy in the WMS.
  • Apply storage requirements based on product type, temperature zone, FEFO, weight, and product movement.
  • Handle damaged goods and discrepancies according to the approved process.
  • Coordinate closely with Receiving and Inventory teams throughout the shift.
  • Train new operators and coach the team on safety and productivity.

Requirements

2–4 years of experience in warehouse operations, including at least 1 year in a team-leading role.

Valid Forklift / Reach Truck license with hands-on operating experience.

Strong knowledge of warehouse safety standards and MHE operations.

Hands-on experience using a WMS, particularly for putaway, locations, and stock movements.

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify item, quantity, batch, or expiry discrepancies.

Ability to work shifts, weekends, and during peak seasons.

Willingness to maintain full-time presence on the warehouse floor.

Basic English and Arabic communication skills.

jobs.title: Receiving Operations
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Inbound Supervisor to lead and oversee the receiving operation of a fast-growing grocery distribution center.

In this role, you will lead a team of Team Leaders and Receiving Officers, manage the flow of goods from supplier arrival through receiving and putaway handover, and ensure that every receipt is processed accurately, safely, and within the required timeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan the daily inbound schedule and allocate manpower based on truck arrivals and inbound volume.
  • Supervise unloading, counting, PO receiving in the WMS, and putaway handover.
  • Ensure all open receipts are closed on the same day with no end-of-shift backlog.
  • Enforce cold chain, FEFO, expiry, and quality control requirements across ambient, chilled, frozen, and fresh products.
  • Lead, train, and develop the receiving team while monitoring individual productivity and performance.
  • Coordinate with Planning, Commercial, and Suppliers to ensure smooth inbound operations.
  • Monitor inbound volumes, productivity, and open receipts.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and support process and system improvements.
  • Maintain strong floor presence and ensure compliance with warehouse procedures and standards.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.

3–5 years of experience in warehouse operations, including 2+ years supervising a receiving/inbound team.

Experience in Grocery, FMCG, Retail, or Food Distribution, preferably with multi-temperature handling.

Hands-on experience with WMS, including receiving, PO/ASN, and putaway.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Solid knowledge of Food Safety, Cold Chain, and Expiry Control.

Proven people management and strong warehouse floor presence.

English and Arabic, written and spoken.

Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and peak seasons.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Receptionist to be the face of our Khobar branch and create a professional, welcoming experience for everyone who walks through our doors.

This role goes beyond answering calls — you’ll manage the front desk, welcome employees and visitors, coordinate meetings, support day-to-day office needs, and ensure the office is always ready for guests, including senior leaders, directors, C-level executives, candidates, and external partners.


What You’ll Do

  • Welcome and assist visitors, employees, candidates, and external guests in a professional and friendly manner.
  • Manage the reception area, visitor registration, calls, and general inquiries.
  • Coordinate meeting rooms and ensure they are fully prepared for scheduled meetings and visitors.
  • Support office requirements, including supplies, couriers, documents, and general administration.
  • Coordinate with HR, Admin, Facilities, Security, and other teams to ensure smooth office operations.
  • Follow up on office maintenance, employee requests, and day-to-day administrative needs.
  • Maintain a professional, organized, and presentable office environment.
  • Handle company and visitor information with discretion and confidentiality.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in reception, front desk, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, HR, or a related field.
  • Strong Arabic and English communication skills.
  • Monitor and maintain office supplies and consumables, including stationery, pantry items, food and beverages, cleaning and hygiene supplies, and ensure they are consistently stocked.
  • Professional appearance, presence, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable interacting with senior executives, visitors, and external stakeholders.
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • A proactive, service-oriented attitude and the ability to manage multiple tasks smoothly.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Legal Specialist to join our Legal Affairs team. The role will focus on drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts and agreements, while providing legal and commercial risk advice to business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial contracts and agreements.
  • Identify and advise on legal and commercial risks within contracts.
  • Provide legal advice to business units on contractual matters.
  • Support complex and high-value contract negotiations.
  • Maintain contract records, approvals, renewals, and key contractual terms.
  • Develop and maintain standard contract templates and playbooks.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel when required.
  • Support dispute resolution related to contractual matters.
  • Mentor junior Legal Specialists and contribute to improving contract processes.

Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB).
    • 4–7 years of experience in contract law, commercial law, or in-house legal practice.
    • Strong hands-on experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts.
    • Experience providing legal advice and assessing contractual risks.
    • Experience in the E-commerce, Technology, or Retail sectors is preferred.
    • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Experience in a holding company or multi-entity environment is a plus.
    • Legal practice license is preferred.

jobs.title: Stock Control Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Stock Control Supervisor to join our Warehouse Operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, supervising stock control activities, leading cycle counts, and resolving stock discrepancies to support efficient distribution center operations.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise the stock control team and daily inventory activities.
  • Conduct cycle counts, full inventory counts, audits, and stock reconciliations.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and ensure timely resolution.
  • Monitor receiving, stocking, picking, transfers, adjustments, and distribution transactions.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records in WMS/ERP systems.
  • Coordinate with Receiving, Picking, Shipping, Quality, Purchasing, and Warehouse teams.
  • Monitor stock levels and help prevent shortages and overstocking.
  • Implement and enforce inventory control procedures and best practices.
  • Apply FIFO principles and monitor expiry dates, aging, slow-moving, and obsolete stock.
  • Ensure bins are correctly labeled and storage locations are logically organized.
  • Improve storage layouts, stock flow, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor inventory KPIs, including stock accuracy, variances, and count completion.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing the required reports and documentation.
  • Train, guide, and evaluate inventory control employees.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and warehouse procedures.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory control, stock management, or warehouse supervision.
  • Previous experience supervising an inventory or warehouse team.
  • Strong knowledge of cycle counting, stock audits, reconciliation, and inventory accuracy.
  • Hands-on experience using WMS and/or ERP systems.
  • Good understanding of warehouse operations, FIFO, stock replenishment, and inventory forecasting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies and implement process improvements.
  • Good communication, coordination, and team-management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is preferred.
  • Relevant inventory, warehouse, or supply chain certifications are an advantage.

jobs.title: Supplier Partnership Matching Specialist
jobs.description:
• Review and verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and contracts to ensure accuracy.
  • Resolve discrepancies in invoice matching and communicate effectively with suppliers to clarify any issues.
  • Maintain accurate records of approved and pending invoices within the financial system.
  • Collaborate with the accounts payable team to facilitate timely payments to suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers to address any concerns related to invoicing and payments.
  • Generate reports on invoice matching activity and supplier performance for internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the development of standard operating procedures for invoice matching and supplier management.
  • Stay updated on industry best practices and compliance regulations related to supplier invoicing and payments.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in invoice processing, accounts payable, or supplier management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

jobs.title: Tamheer - Internal Communication
jobs.description:
We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Internal Communication Trainee to join our team through the Tamheer Program. This role is ideal for someone passionate about employee engagement, internal communication, content creation, and organizing company events

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Communication, Graphic Design, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong design skills using tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Previous experience (academic, internship, volunteer, or professional) in organizing events or employee engagement activities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both Arabic and English.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Good organizational and coordination skills.
  • Must not have previously benefited from the Tamheer Program.
